The following is a high level design overview of the scope of the project.

Mechanical:

2.	Minor process piping modification for skid installation.
3.	Heat trace outdoor storage tank piping. Provide heat trace panels and one control panel per site.

Electrical:
1.	Install new power circuits from existing panel to power the heat trace panels and heat trace control panel.
2.	Install new power circuits from existing panel for the new chlorination skids per site.

Structural:
1.	Mount new heat trace panels and heat trace control panels.
2.	Support the minor processing pipe for skid connection.
